Binance API HMAC Signing — Duplicated in **14 files** **Files**: `accept_btc_quote`, `binance_alpha_live`, `binance_alpha_scan`, `check_earn`, `check_spot`, `convert_btc_now`, `convert_check`, `convert_usdt_to_bnb`, `get_earn_details`, `redeem_all`, `redeem_earn`, `sell_btc`, `trade_monitor`, `withdraw_bnb` **Pattern**: `crypto.createHmac('sha256', API_SECRET).update(body).digest('hex')` **⚠️ SECURITY ISSUE**: API keys are hardcoded in **7 files** (`accept_btc_quote`, `check_earn`, `check_spot`, `convert_btc_now`, `convert_usdt_to_bnb`, `sell_btc`, `withdraw_bnb`, `redeem_earn`, `redeem_all`, `get_earn_details`, `trade_monitor`, `check_meme`). Only `binance_alpha_live`, `binance_alpha_scan`, `rising_star`, and `hot_scan` use `process.env`. **Recommendation**: Extract to `lib/binance.js` with env-based keys. ### 4. DexScreener Data Fetching — Scattered across 15+ files Every scanner fetches from `https://api.dexscreener.com/latest/dex/...` with similar parsing of `priceUsd`, `priceChange.m5/h1/h6/h24`, `volume.m5/h24`, `txns.m5.buys/sells`, `liquidity.usd`, `fdv`. **Recommendation**: Extract to `lib/dexscreener.js` with standardized token data object. ### 5. Monitor Pattern — Identical in 4 files `afob_monitor_v2`, `afob_monitor`, `doge_monitor`, `eth_monitor` all follow: ``` while(true) { fetchData() → calculatePnL() → if (TP) sell(); if (SL) sell(); if (trailingStop) sell(); sleep(INTERVAL); } ``` **Only differences**: Token address, entry params, TP/SL thresholds, trailing stop params. **Recommendation**: A single parameterized `lib/monitor.js` with config object. ### 6. Scoring Logic — UNIQUE to `rising_star.js` The `scoreRisingStar()` and `detectInsiderPattern()` functions are the most valuable logic in the codebase. They evaluate: - Token age (newness) - Buy/sell pressure ratio - Volume explosion (5m vs 1h) - Price momentum - FDV sweet spot ($10k-$5M) - Liquidity health - Trade activity - Insider buying patterns This is **not duplicated anywhere** — it's the brain. --- ## 🏗️ ARCHITECTURE DIAGRAM ```mermaid graph TD subgraph Shared Libs [SHARED - Need Extraction] FETCH[lib/fetch.js
